structuredContent.content:
name: PoN SmolLM cooperating campaign once
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - fix/chain-model-owner-hosted-once-20261105
    paths:
      - config/pon/hosted-model-intents-v1/*.json
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: model-owner-completion-20261104-once-v1
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  original-public-pilot:
    if: github.repository == 'TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 300
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        id: checkout
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.after }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate published intent before setup or downloads
        id: admission
        run: python3 -I -S -B scripts/ci/llm_hosted_once.py validate
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a309ff8b426b58ec0e2a45f0f869d46889d02405
        id: python_setup
        with:
          python-version: '3.12.3'
      - name: Execute the original registered pilot once
        id: execution
        run: python -I -S -B scripts/ci/llm_hosted_once.py execute
      - name: Collect bounded observations without recovery or retry
        if: always()
        env:
          HOSTED_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.checkout.outcome }}
          HOSTED_ADMISSION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.admission.outcome }}
          HOSTED_PYTHON_SETUP_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.python_setup.outcome }}
          HOSTED_EXECUTION_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.execution.outcome }}
        run: python3 -I -S -B scripts/ci/llm_hosted_once.py collect
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02
        if: always()
        with:
          name: smollm-campaign-once-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pon-smollm-hosted-once-v1/evidence/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
          include-hidden-files: false
